title: Dow Jones Futures: Trump Says Iran Deal Near With Hormuz 'Opened'; Tesla, AI Stocks Near Buy Points
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：特朗普称伊朗与霍尔木兹海峡的协议已“开启”；特斯拉、人工智能股票接近买入点
summary: President Donald Trump said Saturday that the U.S. and Iran are close to an interim deal that will open the Strait of Hormuz.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，美国和伊朗即将达成开放霍尔木兹海峡的临时协议。

title: Uber Proposes Delivery Hero Takeover at €10 Billion Valuation
title_zh: Uber 提议以 100 亿欧元的估值收购 Delivery Hero
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Uber Technologies Inc. has offered to take over Delivery Hero SE in a deal that would value the German delivery company at about €10 billion ($11.6 billion) as it seeks to ramp up competition with DoorDash Inc. outside the US.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Uber Technologies Inc. 已提出收购 Delivery Hero SE，该交易将使这家德国快递公司估值约为 100 亿欧元（116 亿美元），以加强与美国以外地区 DoorDash Inc. 的竞争。

title: KKR Reshapes Portfolio With Exits And Energy Deals In Focus
title_zh: KKR 重塑投资组合，重点关注退出和能源交易
summary: KKR agreed to sell Circor Aerospace in a definitive deal, marking an exit from an industrial aerospace holding. The firm completed its exit from Kokusai Electric, closing out a semiconductor investment.
summary_zh: KKR 同意以最终协议出售 Circor Aerospace，标志着退出工业航空航天控股公司。该公司完成了从国际电气的退出，结束了一项半导体投资。

title: How The Akamai Technologies (AKAM) Story Is Shifting With AI Deals And Margin Debate
title_zh: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) 的故事如何随着人工智能交易和利润争论而转变
summary: The analyst fair value estimate for Akamai Technologies moved from US$110.98 to US$157.16, a sizeable uplift that puts fresh focus on how investors are framing the stock.
summary_zh: 分析师对 Akamai Technologies 的公允价值预期从 110.98 美元升至 157.16 美元，这一大幅提升让投资者重新关注该股的走势。

title: Oracle Samsung Java Deal Ties Semiconductor Software To Long Term Cloud Story
title_zh: Oracle 三星 Java 交易将半导体软件与长期云故事联系起来
summary: Oracle and Samsung Electronics have expanded their partnership to standardize semiconductor software development on Oracle Java SE Universal Subscription.
summary_zh: Oracle 和三星电子扩大了合作伙伴关系，以标准化 Oracle Java SE 通用订阅上的半导体软件开发。
